ITEM 1 | Bowl of cooked grain-like mixture, pale beige to cream color with small rounded grains and a slightly glossy, moist, soft surface; looks spoon-smooth with a thick, flowing consistency that spreads to fill the bowl, with faint darker specks scattered throughout; fills about 15 cm white bowl interior (roughly 11 cm diameter, about 3 cm deep) | 280

ITEM 2 | Raspberries, bright red with a bumpy, drupelet-textured surface, some slightly darker and crumbly, heaped in a small white bowl at upper left, covering roughly a third of that bowl's surface with individual berries about 2 cm across | 90

ITEM 3 | Blackberries, dark purple-black glossy drupelets clustered together, heaped in a small white bowl at lower left, covering roughly a quarter of that bowl's surface, individual berries about 1.5 cm across | 60
